verdict.rationale: BigQuery ships an official Python-based CLI tool ('bq') well documented for creating datasets, loading data, and querying tables, confirmed across multiple docs and a dedicated probe entry. Missing for 10: no independent/hands-on community corroboration specifically of the CLI's agentic/scripting fit for AI-native workflows, and no explicit mention of CLI support for AI-specific features (e.g., piping to LLM agents).
